name: MiniMax H3 — transform a video by reference + audio
title: Edit a video, sound and all
summary: Upload a clip and say what to swap — the person, a costume, an object, the setting — and what to keep; you get the same shot, the same moves and timing, with your change and a new soundtrack. Slow (several minutes).
description:
Upload a source clip and describe how to transform it. MiniMax H3 watches your clip as a reference (call it <Video 1> in the prompt, with the angle brackets) and generates a new video that keeps what you ask it to keep — choreography, timing, camera move — and replaces what you name: a person, a costume, an object, the setting. It is an EDIT of your clip; to restyle the whole clip (everything in clay, in watercolour...), the canny and depth cards do that better. A new audio track is generated from your prompt.

Nothing is traced frame by frame (unlike the ControlNet versions), so the wording matters a lot: say explicitly what to retain from <Video 1> and what to change. Write it the way the model was trained, as the default prompt does: name the clip <Video 1> with the angle brackets, start the summary with [video editing] and "The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.", mark each element removed, partially_preserved or attribute_transfer under retention_analysis, then the shot, and the sound under overall_soundscape and non_diegetic_music. A prompt that names "Video 1" without brackets, or asks to keep everything, gets the source back unchanged.

This is the slowest MiniMax workflow: the whole reference clip rides along every sampling step. Keep clips short ("Duration", default 5 s; only the start of your clip is used) and use "Fast mode" (4-step turbo LoRA) when you are exploring ideas.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 reference-mode prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Say what to keep from each input and what changes; describe the action, camera and sound concretely — everything should be visible or audible.

exposedParameters.default:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the edit: one continuous handheld shot of a man dancing on a flat grey rooftop under an overcast sky, with brick factory buildings, a tall brick chimney and a city skyline behind him.
<Subject 1> is the dancer in <Video 1>: a bearded man in a black tracksuit with red stripes on the sleeves and black sneakers, selected for replacement.
<Subject 2> is a knight in full polished steel plate armour with a closed visor helmet topped by a red plume and a red cloth tabard over the breastplate, replacing <Subject 1>.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. <Subject 2> replaces <Subject 1> and performs exactly the same dance on the same rooftop, while the rooftop, the brick buildings, the chimney, the cloudy sky, the handheld camera and the timing of <Video 1> are kept.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (rooftop setting, camera movement and timing): partially_preserved - keep the rooftop, the background buildings, the chimney, the overcast light, the framing, the handheld camera movement and the exact timing of every move; change only the dancer.
<Subject 1>: removed - the man in the black tracksuit does not appear in any frame of the target video.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the knight takes over every step, arm wave, body pop, squat and pose of the dance of <Subject 1>, in the same positions and at the same moments.

detailed_description:
The target video keeps the live-action, overcast, slightly desaturated look of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] Follow the framing, the handheld camera movement and the action timing of <Video 1>. On the grey rooftop, in front of the brick factory buildings and the tall chimney, <Subject 2> dances in place of <Subject 1>: the knight in polished steel plate armour, closed visor and red-plumed helmet sweeps his armoured arms out wide, pops his chest, raises one gauntlet high, drops into a wide squat and steps from side to side exactly as the original dancer does, the red tabard swinging with each move and the cloudy daylight sliding across the steel. Only the knight is visible, from the first frame to the last.

overall_soundscape:
Metal plates clank and scrape in time with every step and arm movement, steel boots ring on the rooftop, and a steady city wind blows over the roof with distant traffic far below.

non_diegetic_music:
An upbeat hip-hop drum beat at a moderate tempo with a deep kick and a crisp snare that hits on the sharpest moves.

warmupParams.primitivestringmultiline_value_138: Keep the motion and camera of Video 1. Turn the subject into a bronze statue in a sunny park. Audio: soft wind.
